shots.line: Part two. Saying yes to three hundred dollars without a plan is how you lose the client.
If you picked A, start from real photos of the product, so the AI copies it.
Then the same steps every time: scene, motion, voice, and a quick check for anything that looks fake.
That's the one thing that makes A safe. I put every step in a kit. DM me kit.
Part two. Your client says the video looks fake. Here are the three things I'd fix first.
One: the writing on the product. If the label melts or changes, people notice right away.
shots.room: bright product photography studio white table

shots.line: Two: the size. The product can't grow or shrink between shots. Three: the hands.
Fix those three and redo it free. My full check is in the kit. DM me kit.

shots.line: Part two. You picked B: one week learning AI product videos. Here's what that week looks like.
Days one and two: pick one product and take five clear photos of it with your phone.
shots.room: bright home desk with phone tripod

shots.line: Days three to five: turn them into short clips, and post one every day.
Days six and seven: see what got views, and make more of that. Free starter list, link in bio.
